title.h3: Don't believe it? Watch the video

whatIsContent: Its a lesson planning system focused for teachers and educators. With our system, you spend less time developing lesson plans. Everything becomes simpler.Our goal is clear: allow you to have more productivity and freedom in your week. Forget the time spent on lesson planning. Everything gets easier with planossauro
feature_ia_desc: We use AI to automate and generate your lesson plan according to your needs
featureCloud_desc: We store your lesson plan in the cloud. Having a backup is never a bad thing
featurePrice_desc: We have super affordable prices, from free plans to plans that fit your budget
featureDinos_desc: Our app is full of cool dinosaurs that make the experience more light and fun
featureEasy_desc: Our system was designed to be easy to use, uncomplicated, because life is complicated enough
featureSupport_desc: We want our system to be as complete as possible. Contact our support and share improvement ideas
humansForHumansContent: 100% handmade system that solves a real problem. We're not a corporate app nor an AI-created app. We're completely human (or better, dinosaurs)
help_content_2: Below you'll find buttons to help you
help_content_3: Support email: suporte.planossauro at gmail.com or gsantos15569.dev at gmail.com
faq_1_q: Can I use the system for free?
faq_1_a: Yes, we have a free plan to demonstrate how our app works. You can use it forever, as all tokens are renewed monthly
faq_2_a: Basically, you have a limit of lesson plans. This limit is called "tokens". When you create a plan, you spend 1 token. When you reach the token limit, you need to upgrade or wait 1 month for your tokens back
faq_3_a: For now, only credit cards (Visa and Mastercard) and Google Pay. In the future, we'll also implement Apple Pay.
faq_4_a: Yes, we use STRIPE, a payment system used globally by many large companies like Ford, Uber, Amazon, etc. Therefore, when you make a payment, a new payment page opens. We don't store any sensitive information that could compromise your data
faq_5_q: What happens when canceling a plan?
faq_5_a: Your plan returns to the free demo and you receive the refund
faq_6_a: Operating costs and charity: 10% of the profits will go to charity to provide better education for people in need, and the rest will be used to pay for hosting and server costs.
footer: Thanks for coming this far, app made with ❤️ by Gustavo S. Melo
